title: Accounting Schedule
description: A supporting worksheet (like a list of every unit in inventory) that has to add up to exactly what a GL account says, so the accountant can prove the balance is real.
x-sap-analogue: Subledger reconciliation / open-item list tied to a control account (like FI open items vs. a GL reconciliation account)
x-api-note: Accounting schedules are described only at a workflow/concept level in CDK/dealer-accounting materials; no Fortellis API for schedule detail lines was found.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

control_account_number.description: The GL account balance this schedule has to reconcile to exactly
control_account_number.x-source-title: GM Dealer Standard Accounting Manual — schedule/control account discussion

schedule_line_item_unit_ro_claim_referen.description: Each line is a real open item — a stock number, an open RO, or an unpaid claim — that together should sum to the control balance

schedule_balance_vs_gl_balance_variance.description: The month-end check: schedule total minus GL account balance should be zero

floor_plan_schedule_unit_level_payable.description: A named example schedule type: the floor-plan payable broken out by individual financed unit

warranty_receivable_schedule_open_claim_.description: A named example schedule type: open/submitted warranty claims awaiting factory payment

wip_schedule_open_ro_list.description: A named example schedule type: every open repair order and the cost posted to it so far
